thread:
maya: heads-up — i'm starting a proposal to migrate console analytics from the single `usage_events` blob to an append-only eventstore + a lightweight per-tenant projection table for dashboard KPIs. feedback wanted on read-adapter/shim strategy.
cal: quick q — why not keep JSONB and add indexes? worried about index cost and query hotspots.
maya: JSONB is fine for raw storage, but dashboards and quota checks need fast, low-cardinality indexes. separate projection lets us TTL/compact independently and tune PKs.
jon: how are we planning writes during rollout? dualwrite? shadow?
maya: plan sketch: 1) shadow-write to new eventstore for 7 days, 2) enable dualwrite to `metric_projection` for canary traffic (1%), 3) ramp dualwrite, 4) run streaming replay/backfill for 180d historical data into projection. reads will prefer projection when available, fallback to old store.
priya: console p99 is sensitive — projection should store pre-aggregated hourly buckets to avoid heavy group-bys on dashboards and quota checks. also need per-route quota columns.
maya: agreed. rough projection DDL below — we can iterate: 
```sql
CREATE TABLE metric_projection (
  tenant_id UUID,
  route_key INT, -- compact numeric foreign key to route_dim
  hour_ts TIMESTAMP,
  hits BIGINT,
  tokens BIGINT,
  quota_bucket TEXT,
  source_version TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, route_key, hour_ts)
);
```
cal: route_key is good. index size will still grow — suggest splitting TTL tiers (hot 30d, warm 180d) and storing longtail in object storage snapshots. also route_dim to hold metadata.
maya: yep will add route_dim and retention tiers. route_dim will hold route_id string, labels, and cardinality hints.
jon: backfill details — we should implement an idempotent streaming replay (use event id + dedupe) and ship provenance (source_version) so projections can be re-materialized if we change logic. cannot block reads; backfill should be background rate-limited.
priya: add observability: batch-level metrics, drift detectors between old vs new (counts, tokens, p99s). also sample payloads for QA.
maya: rollout plan: docs PR by Mon, canary dualwrite -> 1% traffic next Wed, ramp to 20% after green checks, full dualwrite in ~2w. backfill will run at ~30% of ingest throughput to limit DB impact. fallback via query-router flag per-tenant. :eyes: :shipit:
ingest-bot: replay job scheduled: `replay-projection-2026-03-22 04:00 UTC` (owner: sam)
sam: i'll own runbook and coordinate infra (kafka consumer job + dedupe store). i'll open runbook draft and add checklist.
cal: action items i see: 1) schema DDL PR, 2) read-adapter shim + query-router flag, 3) route_dim DDL + migration plan, 4) streaming replay job with idempotency, 5) observability/diff dashboards. i'll pick up DDL PR.
maya: thanks — i'll draft the read-adapter shim design and sample queries we need to keep backwards compat for dashboards. i'll ping here when PRs are up.
jon: we should also add an automated schema-compat check in CI for projection DDL to avoid accidental PK changes during fast iteration.
priya: +1. also add evaluation harness to compare quota calc between old store and projection for a tenant subset before full cutover.
maya: noted — adding evaluation step to canary checklist.
cal: anything else? otherwise lgtm for initial design.
maya: nothing else for now — will post the design doc link once drafted.
